summary: Iteration 29: tested star ratings, Referral Quick Share to a fixed channel, Home 'New templates & resources' highlights, and the confirm step for removing AGTS places. Backend: 5/5 pytest pass (run serially with -n 0; the repo's pytest.ini enables xdist, and parallel workers break the module fixture). Frontend: all 7 requested flows pass at 375x667. All share testing used a temporary TEST_ channel without a webhook, because 'Allied Health' and 'Celebrate the Wins' have gchat_webhook set, so a share there also posts to real Google Chat. No deprecated Expo packages detected.

minor.issue: No duplicate or throttle guard: each call posts a new channel message. With the UI's lack of a busy state, a double-tap posts twice. If the chosen channel has gchat_webhook, the share is also mirrored to external Google Chat (may be intended).
conversations.last_message stores the multi-line text with \n characters. The chat list uses numberOfLines=1, so this is only cosmetic.

integration_issues.issue: directory-new.tsx (line ~92) invalidates ['directory'] but not ['directory-highlights']. That is a separate key, not matched by prefix. directory.tsx delete doesn't invalidate it either. On native the Home tab stays mounted and refetchOnFocus is off, so a newly added or removed Template/Resource won't show on Home until pull-to-refresh. On web it updated during my test, probably because my navigation remounted Home.

issues: 'Share to chat' posts immediately with no confirmation and no loading/disabled state, so a double-tap sends duplicate posts to a real team channel.
The channel picker sheet has no Close/Cancel button; it can only be dismissed by tapping the scrim or with back.
The long header title 'Therapist · Trusted Referral Partner Organisations' is truncated at 375px.

The list re-sorts as soon as you rate, so the card you just tapped jumps position (Alpha moved from 2nd to 1st and back). This is disorienting; consider delaying the re-sort or keeping the position until refresh.
Rating can't be cleared, because tapping the same star again does nothing. Minor.
The 'New' pill on home-resource cards sits top-aligned rather than vertically centred with the text block. Minor.

action_items: Invalidate ['directory-highlights'] after directory add/edit/delete (directory-new.tsx save, directory.tsx remove) so Home reflects changes on native.
Add a busy/disabled state, and optionally a confirm, to the 'Share to chat' button to prevent duplicate channel posts.
Optional: add a Close button to directory-channel-sheet; consider not re-sorting immediately after rating.
critical_code_review_comments: Routes /directory/highlights and /directory/share-channel are correctly declared before /directory/{entry_id}.
The raw ratings dict is popped in shape(), so it is never exposed. Edit uses $set of FIELDS only, so ratings survive edits (verified).
share_channel() handles a deleted channel by returning null, and PUT rejects DMs and unknown IDs with 404 (verified).
seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_ directory entries, a TEST_ place and channel conv_TEST_refshare were created and then fully removed. The referral_share_channel settings doc was deleted (unset, as in production). No messages were posted to real channels, and real channels' last_message/last_at are unchanged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run iter29 pytest with '-n 0' (pytest.ini uses xdist). Never share to real channels: Allied Health and Celebrate the Wins mirror to Google Chat via gchat_webhook. Use seed_iter29_ui.py seed/clean, which creates and removes conv_TEST_refshare.
